new_variants: Joyful laugh: eyes curve into happy crescents but retain the same eye placement; mouth opens in a clear cheerful laugh with a small visible dark mouth interior, no teeth, no tongue, no changed muzzle.
Sad with tears: upper eyelids lift slightly, pupils look down, two small clean tear shapes sit below the eyes, mouth corners turn down clearly; do not alter face outline or markings.
Surprised: eyes open wider without changing their size or spacing, pupils centered, mouth opens into a small round shape; no giant eyes and no face deformation.
Fear/panic: eyelids raised, pupils slightly contracted, gaze fixed forward, mouth open in a tense small gasp; dramatic but controlled, no screaming distortion.
Intense anger: eyelids lower strongly, pupils fixed in a sharp direct gaze, mouth opens in a firm angry call with visible dark mouth interior but no teeth; keep head and muzzle geometry unchanged.
Disgust: one eyelid lowers more than the other, gaze shifts sideways, mouth tightens with a slight asymmetric curl; clearly displeased but do not warp cheeks or nose.
Deep grief: eyelids press closed, two bold but simple tear streams on the cream cheek areas, mouth opens in a sorrowful cry; preserve all fur colors and stripe marks beneath/around tears.
Exhaustion: eyelids nearly closed, pupils low, mouth slightly open as if breathing out, expression visibly drained; no change to cheek silhouette, fur colors or tabby map.
